race.comment: CANTANKEROUS (6) has been up for some time, and is still holding his form since progressing to this grade following his win at Ipswich near the beginning of this season. He performs best on a good surface, and from a good draw with 2kg less to carry than last time, he can take this out. VANDEVELDE (5) resumes from a spell, and was contesting some handy 3YO fields prior to his spell. He has not been seen at any public trials, and also cops a bad draw, but with some luck, he can run into the money late. BIT OF GRUNT (1) has not helped himself this season by making slow starts, and his best work has been late in the run home in each of his 2 runs back from a spell. He likes some cut in the ground, and is worth one more chance. MEASURE UP (10) failed to fire fresh up, but is expected to be a lot more competitive with that run under his belt. Top 4 value.
